name: tipout-app

scripts.build: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www/vendor && cp index.html manifest.json service-worker.js icon-192.png icon-512.png version.json www/ && cp vendor/supabase-js.min.js www/vendor/ && (cp revenuecat.config.js www/ 2>/dev/null || cp revenuecat.config.example.js www/revenuecat.config.js) && npx esbuild src/revenuecat-init.js --bundle --format=iife --outfile=www/vendor/revenuecat.bundle.js
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync

description: Daily Tipout - nightly tipout calculator and tip tracker (PWA + Capacitor iOS/Android shells)
